title: Conservation of mass for solutions of Leibenson's equation on Riemannian Manifolds
summary: We consider on a Riemannian manifold $M$ the Leibenson equation \begin{equation*}\label{eqabs}\partial _{t}u=Δ_{p}u^{q},\end{equation*} where $p>1$ and $q>0$.
